# Sudowrite

> > Sudowrite is an AI-powered writing platform purpose-built for fiction authors, offering tools for novel generation, character development, plot outlining, and fan fiction creation.

Sudowrite provides specialized AI models and writing assistants designed specifically for creative fiction writers. The platform combines advanced language models with story-specific features to help authors develop plots, create characters, generate outlines, and write entire novels across multiple genres including fan fiction.

## Core Products & Features

- [Sudowrite Muse](https://sudowrite.com/muse): Exclusive AI model designed specifically for fiction authors
- [AI Novelist](https://sudowrite.com/ai-novelist): Generates chapter outlines and character arcs for complete stories
- [Writing Assistant](https://sudowrite.com/writing-assistant): AI story writing tool with plot and story development capabilities
- [Creative Writing Assistant](https://sudowrite.com/creative-writing-assistant): AI fiction assistant for plot, narrative, and character development
- [AI Novel Generator](https://sudowrite.com/ai-novel-generator): Creates detailed chapter outlines and character profiles for novels
- [AI Book Generator](https://sudowrite.com/ai-book-generator): Generates comprehensive chapter outlines and story structure

## Story & Plot Tools

- [Story Generator](https://sudowrite.com/story-generator): Free story generator providing unique plot ideas with 3-act breakdowns
- [Story Plot Generator](https://sudowrite.com/story-plot-generator): AI plot generator creating story structures with character arcs
- [Narrative Generator](https://sudowrite.com/narrative-generator): Creates chapter outlines and develops character narratives

## Fan Fiction Tools

- [Fandom Super Generator](https://sudowrite.com/fandom-super-generation): AI fan fiction generator for Harry Potter, Marvel, BTS and popular franchises
- [Fandom Helper](https://sudowrite.com/fandom-helper): AI assistant for creating authentic fan fiction stories across fandoms
